system.summary: One-part English code of page,word groups in a roughly alphabetical book of about 445 pages, with letter groups for spelling names and inflection suffixes, used inline in clear English.
system.doubled_letters: written twice in spelled names (RUSSIANS, EECHMIASIN, MOOSHA)
system.notes: Groups are separated by stops; commas join page and word. A third number marks inflection (177,12 have, 177,12,2 had). Function words take ,2 groups on many pages. Pages 442-443 hold personal names.

prior_solution.where: 212/217: no decipherment on the leaves and no edition found (web search 29 Oct 2026). 49: read at the time; its clear copy is /51.

conditions.human_role: Asked for a Middle East archive sweep with online images, chose to view the c. 1802 Jones letters, and asked for this target to be opened and the 1798 values tested on 1802. No target-specific hints.

solution.what: QDL sweep (research/qdl/) found 212/217 ('Letter in Cypher', c. 1802); qdl.qa returns 403 to curl, so images were read in the desktop app's browser from iiif.qdl.qa.
Searched QDL for Jones's cipher items; found /49 (Jones to Dundas, 1798, in code) and /51, catalogued as its decoded copy, which is headed 'Copy - Original in Cypher. Secret.'
Transcribed /49 (two pages of page,word groups mixed with clear words) and /51 (clear) from IIIF crops.

Read the first lines of /49 against /51: one group per word (a = 1,1; confidential 75,2; conversation 75,28), clear words left in, suffixes (230,1 ing = making), and names spelled with letter groups whose pages rise with the alphabet (CONSTANTINOPLE, RUSSIANS). Concluded a one-part alphabetical code.

align.py: dynamic-programming alignment of 49 with 51 over (group, word, letter position), seeded letter groups, learning new letters (G 161,70). First run misaligned at the f. 1v catchword and at ENGLAND; fixed by dropping the catchword and allowing unseeded letters.
Transcribed /217 (2 pp.) and /212 (6 pp.) from IIIF crops.

apply.py: applied the 1798 table to 212/217. 1798 values cover 50% of 217's 128 groups and 57% of 212's 580 (mostly letter groups; 1798 word groups recur only 19 times, each in sense: received, Bacha, Government, party, put, then, some).

Fixed the letter groups the 1798 letter does not use from spelled names in 1802 (B 28,1 ABDULLAH/BAGDAD; H 174,7; K 213,8 KARAPET/KARS; M 228,45 MERDIN/ERZEROUM; Z 440,72; Y 439,66 BAYEZEED; F 141,67 SEFLIS; second codes C 49,10 ASTRACHAN, N 249,48). Raises coverage to 68% (217) and 78% (212).

Proposed values for open word groups from their alphabet stretch and context (95,32 dated; 255,4 November; 188,31 January; 378,44 Tartar; 164,30 General; 272,17 Patriarch; 128,21 Emperor; 149,56 Firman; 394,37 troops). Not yet checked across repeats.
Web search for any decipherment or study of Harford Jones's cipher: none found.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 645 tokens, 96 types, en-modern order 4: reading -2.669 per letter; random keys -3.814 (z 4.1); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.317 (mean -2.34, z -15.1); annealer on the real text -2.003. Verdict: underdetermined.

Opened siblings /214, /243, /244, /274, /211, /213 on QDL. /214 uses a different homophonic two-digit alphabet for dates and names (RESHED, NOV, JAN, ARMENIANS); the rest are clear. None is a clear copy of a coded letter.

Bracketed the open groups by page position in the alphabet and context (proposals.tsv, 98 groups graded H/M/L): e.g. ALTOON IAAK = altun ayak "golden leg", the convent of the three churches = Uch Kilise; three misreadings resolved to 1798 values; 1798 table corrected (169,25 Government, 327,66 said).
apply.py --retry: 645 of 708 groups (91%) at grade H or better, 32 M, 25 L, 6 open.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.664; polyphony 0.005; 1112 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.003

outcome.method: key recovered based on plaintext from external sources
